categories_thin: Architecture - still thin: only Office Space Planners, Farrell Partnership (engineering/architecture), Feifer I J Associates and Winton Group Architecture surfaced in East Brunswick; most architecture work in the area appears to be done by firms based in Edison/New Brunswick.
Land surveying - only Tectonic and CME Associates were identifiable; surveying is usually a service line of engineering firms here rather than a standalone business.

Appraisal - no dedicated East Brunswick appraisal firms were confirmed. Otteau Group was checked and its listed office is in Matawan, not East Brunswick; the one East Brunswick appraiser in the state approved list is listed at a residential street address, which is outside the business-contact rule, so it was not included.
Independent (non-franchise) real estate brokerages - most directory listings are individual agents at Coldwell Banker/Weichert/RE-MAX/Century 21 offices, which are excluded as franchise locations.
caveats: Source spine caveat: the earlier version leaned on FindOpen (republishing Cylex data) for most entries. find-open.com and cylex.us.com returned HTTP 403 to the independent checker, and did so again during this revision, so the single-directory entries could not be re-read. Where a second source was found the entry says so; entries marked 'One FindOpen listing only - unconfirmed' rest on that one directory and must be confirmed by triage.

Re-verification done in this revision: Luzzi Law Firm, Timothy J. Dey, Manchel NJ Bankruptcy Law, Hoffman & Hoffman, Frazer Evangelista Sahni, Pickus & Aronson, Withum, ShieldPros, Ajulia, Samuel H. Davis, Prestige Homes and Land Realty, Land Quest Title, CLIXX, ACS IT Support, Winton Group Architecture were each checked against a page opened or returned by search.

Removed in this revision: Transworld Business Advisors of Middlesex South (franchise location); SIMOS Insourcing Solutions and Accountable Healthcare Staffing (branch offices of national staffing brands); Financial Foundation Services (Ameriprise-branded practice); Wall Street Mortgage (AnnieMac branch page) and Gallo Mortgage Team (branded lender team); Anchor Staffing (business bought by TeleSearch in 2019; TeleSearch's current office list has no East Brunswick location, so it was not replaced).

Exclusion rule applied consistently: brand/franchise outlets and branch pages of out-of-town national brands are excluded; independent or locally headquartered firms with multiple offices (Withum, Wilkin & Guttenplan, Equiliem, Alpha Consulting, Tectonic, Surety Title, Davis Realtors, Advisors Mortgage Group, First Choice Loan Services) are kept, since the 500-person test is about staff at that site.
Many solo practitioners share office suites at 197 Route 18 'Suite 3000', Auer Court, Brier Hill Court and Tices Lane; they are separate businesses, not separate buildings.

Where two directory entries clearly referred to one firm (same phone/address/website) I merged them and said so in notes; Alpha Consulting appeared twice in the earlier list and is now a single entry.
Website fields are blank wherever no company site was seen linked from a listing or opened; personal broker/agent sites and unrelated domains found in the earlier version were cleared.
data_gaps: The checker referred to six missing businesses but named only four in prose (IT MSP, title agency at 214 Highway 18, marketing agency on Milltown Rd, 40-year-old law firm at 197 Route 18 Suite 3000); those four were located and added (ACS IT Support, Land Quest Title, CLIXX Digital Marketing, Rudnick Addonizio Pappa & Casazza). The other two, and the four 'unconfirmed candidates' mentioned in the coverage note, were never named in issues.json, so they could not be chased.

Yellowpages, BBB.org, Cylex direct, Manta, MapQuest, WhereOrg, Opendi and OpenStreetMap Overpass returned 403/502 or blocked pages from this environment; acsitsupport.com and activetitlenj.com also blocked or required JavaScript, so their details come from search results for their own pages.
Google Maps shows only a limited view (about 5 results per search, no paging) and Bing Maps about 9, so map coverage is a supplement, not a spine.

East Brunswick township's own business/resource directory lists municipal and regional resources, not local businesses; the East Brunswick Regional Chamber member directory renders through a JavaScript widget and returned no readable list.
NJ state professional licence look-ups (accountants, engineers, real estate) were not queried because they require interactive form sessions.
Active Title LLC (214 Highway 18) appeared in search with its own site but the site would not render without JavaScript, so it was left out pending confirmation.
Phone numbers are missing where the source listing showed none; 'Unknown' is used rather than guessed.
